The '''Northern Wastes''' was a region in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:NW" />
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Northern Wastes was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:NW" />
